$comment: Provenance for recorded replay fixtures (tests/run/replay/RULES.md rule 6).
One entry per fixture, keyed by its filename stem. Rule 6 requires the model
name and version, the agent version, the benchmark data_revision, the capture
timestamp, and the release tag of the sweep that produced it.
This file starts with the fixtures captured out-of-band under rule 9. The 243
fixtures that predate it have no entry yet — that backfill is tracked as its
own task (issue #483), and rule 6 calls an entry-less fixture drift, so this
file is the place it gets paid down rather than a new convention.

notes: First fixture for the walle structured-output conformance benchmark,
captured to release it (RULES.md rule 21a). Recorded end-to-end against
the mock agent driving task 0 (TestAdditionalProperties, expect=accept)
through the litellm gateway, whose model route pinned to gpt-4.1-mini
served by Azure via the internal ete-litellm LiteLLM proxy.
release_tag is null: out-of-band capture between release cycles, which
rule 9 permits; the next live fleet sweep supersedes it.
The gateway's recorded api_base pointed at an internal-only host; per
rule 4a it was scrubbed to litellm.example.invalid before commit. No
credential was present in the trace (all user_api_key_* fields empty).
Renamed from walle-0-mock with native agent mode (#577): the harness made
these calls, not the mock agent. Traces unchanged.
Captured on the OpenShift cluster c111-e-us-east (native amd64). DeepSWE's
upstream per-task bases are amd64-only single manifests, so this fixture
cannot be re-recorded or replayed on arm64 at all (see eval.platforms).
release_tag is null because the capture was out-of-band between release
cycles, which is exactly what rule 9 permits; the next live fleet sweep
supersedes it.
Recorded with OPENCODE_DISABLE_AUTOCOMPACT=1: opencode's auto-compaction
silently summarizes context mid-run, which would make the recorded turn
sequence a summary rather than the real trajectory.
Recorded by #527's live compose run (tasks 0-9, azure/FW-GLM-5.2) when bfcl
became a model-only native-harness benchmark; renamed from bfcl-0-claude-code
with native agent mode (#577): the harness made these calls, not an agent.
